note_on_the_timeline: The feature extraction of the ImageNet-200 / CIFAR-100 training images and of the CIFAR-100 CLIP features began before the public commit (it involves no evaluation and no choice); every evaluation ran after it. The paper (Appendix: hypotheses) states this.

hypotheses_outcome.H1: confirmed (CIFAR-100 far-OOD +0.24, ImageNet-200 near-OOD -0.53 FPR95 points vs p+ only, capped Storey rule)
hypotheses_outcome.H2: confirmed (ImageNet-1K near-OOD: -0.18 standalone, +0.19 x TINS vs the uncapped rule)
hypotheses_outcome.H3: confirmed (0 of the 2 cells with mixing rate >= 0.3 worse than p+ only by > 1 point; max |capped - uncapped| = 0.3 in the 28 cells with r >= 10 and mixing rate < 0.3)
hypotheses_outcome.H4: first half refuted (kNN over all training images, k = 50, does not beat the 16-label static read-out on ImageNet-200 (28.04 vs 26.72 near, 4.40 vs 3.71 far) nor on CIFAR-100 far-OOD (32.15 vs 29.19); it does on CIFAR-100 near-OOD (16.35 vs 16.49)); second half confirmed (sigma 9.07 / p+ only 7.45 vs kNN-all 28.04 near-OOD FPR95 on ImageNet-200)
hypotheses_outcome.H5: first half refuted (the r at which sigma first beats the static read-out does not decrease with smaller k_g: NINCO r = 10 for k_g in {3, 5, 10, 20} and r = 1 for k_g = 40; SSB-hard r = 2 for k_g <= 10 and r = 1 for k_g >= 20); second half partially confirmed (best at the largest r: k_g = 10 on NINCO, k_g = 5 on SSB-hard with k_g = 10 within 0.3)
hypotheses_outcome.H6: first half refuted (centred CLIP static read-out: near 91.41, far 78.46 FPR95); second half confirmed for the static read-out (DINO views move at most 8.97 points) and not for the kNN rank (DINO v1 far-OOD moves 10.92 points)
